These profound truths are found to be in a time-space continuum, as these messages not only provide knowledge on the astral world but also render timely messages/ advice for one’s spiritual growth. ‘Pathshala’ is one of a kind platform that provides knowledge on several mysteries lying in the astral world in different formats to reach all aspirants and make them aware of the several challenges and intricacies that lie. This makes the spiritual journey hassle-free and makes an aspirant focus more on ‘Bhakti’ tattva instead.
